stories.headline: Nvidia opens independent review of Huang allegations
stories.summary: Nvidia is reviewing allegations that CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. Reuters could not independently verify the claims. Nvidia says it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised.

stories.headline: Trump signals openness to AI safeguards
stories.summary: Trump said on CBS he was open to AI safeguards and working with Democrats, while opposing restrictions that disadvantage the US against China. No specific legislation, regulatory framework or enacted policy was announced.

stories.headline: China extends US trade truce by two months
stories.summary: China extended the suspension of a 24% additional tariff on US imports; a 10% tariff remains. Critical-mineral waivers and other suspensions also continue. This extends a truce rather than completing a comprehensive trade agreement.

stories.headline: Qatar mediation continues; Iran deal not imminent
stories.summary: Trump and Vance are due to meet Qatar's prime minister today. US and Gulf officials see substantial obstacles to an Iran settlement. Iranian reports of overnight strikes are not independently established in this account.

stories.headline: COP31 opens with electrification push
stories.summary: COP31 opened in Turkey with a proposed goal to electrify more than one-third of the global economy by 2035. Critics say the pledge does not require low-carbon electricity. An opening proposal is not an agreed final summit outcome.
